info.title: Intelligent Incident Analysis & AI Assistance API
info.description: REST contracts for managing technology incidents and orchestrating AI assistance with n8n.

tags.name: Knowledge Base (RF02)
tags.description: Technical articles. Only active and verified ones are used as sources by the AI assistant.

tags.name: AI Assistance (n8n Integration)
tags.description: Endpoints to trigger the analysis in n8n, store responses with their sources, rate suggestions and read the history

tags.name: Analytics & KPIs (RF06)
tags.description: Endpoints for resolution rate, average time, distribution by category/priority/status, weekly/monthly trends and pending/overdue incidents

tags.name: Authentication
tags.description: JWT login and profile of the authenticated user

tags.name: Incidents Management (RF01)
tags.description: Endpoints to create, read, update, change the status of and filter technology incidents

tags.name: Catalogs
tags.description: Technical categories and users for forms and filters

get.summary: Get a knowledge article by ID

put.description: If the title or the content changes, the article becomes unverified again.

404.description: Article, category or author not found
Incident, user or category not found

409.description: The incident is already closed (CLOSED) or the category is inactive

get.description: Optional filters: q (text in the title or content), categoryId, active and verified.

200.description: Articles that match the filters, newest first

post.description: The article starts active and unverified.

get.summary: Filter incidents dynamically by category, priority, status, user, and date range

200.description: Incidents that match the filters, newest first

400.description: Priority, status or date with an invalid format

409.description: The start date is after the end date

post.description: The incident starts in the OPEN status.

post.summary: Log in and get a JWT
post.description: Returns a Bearer token. Send it in the header Authorization: Bearer <token>.

400.description: Email or password with an invalid format

post.summary: Register AI response and sources (Callback webhook from n8n)
post.description: Saves the n8n response (AiResponse) together with its sources (ResponseSource) and their similarity. Marks the AiQuery as COMPLETED when there are sources, or NO_RESULTS when n8n found no relevant documents. If app.callback.token is set, the X-Callback-Token header is required.

409.description: The query already has a response

post.description: Lets a technician or user rate from 1 to 5 how useful an AI-generated response was.

400.description: Score outside 1 to 5 or incomplete data

404.description: AI response or evaluating user not found

409.description: The AI response was already rated

post.summary: Request AI incident analysis (Trigger to n8n)
post.description: Records the AiQuery, moves the incident to IN_AI_ANALYSIS, calls n8n over HTTP and marks COMMUNICATION_ERROR on a timeout or error.

202.description: Request accepted and saved in the database

400.description: Invalid input (for example, an empty description)

post.summary: Report an AI processing failure (Callback webhook from n8n)
post.description: Marks the query as FAILED and stores the failure code and message. If app.callback.token is set, the X-Callback-Token header is required.

409.description: The query already has a response or the ID does not match

patch.summary: Activate, deactivate or verify a knowledge article

409.description: Neither active nor verified was sent

patch.summary: Update the status of an existing incident

get.description: Optional filter by role: EMPLOYEE, SUPPORT_TECHNICIAN or ADMIN.
With activeOnly=true it returns only the active categories.
Groups incidents by ISO week (Year-Week), showing the number of reported and resolved incidents.

400.description: Priority or date with an invalid format

409.description: The start date is after the end date

get.description: Returns the categories ordered from most to fewest incidents, with their percentage of the filtered total.

400.description: Priority or date with an invalid format

409.description: The start date is after the end date

get.description: Groups incidents by month (YYYY-MM), showing the number of reported and resolved incidents.

400.description: Priority or date with an invalid format

409.description: The start date is after the end date

get.summary: Get consolidated analytics dashboard KPIs (All 10 RF06 metrics)
get.description: Computes in the database the total, pending, overdue, resolution rate, average time in hours, AI rating, categories, priorities, statuses and weekly/monthly trends.

400.description: Priority or date with an invalid format

409.description: The start date is after the end date

get.description: Returns the count and percentage of incidents in each status (OPEN, IN_AI_ANALYSIS, ASSIGNED_TO_TECH, RESOLVED, CLOSED).

400.description: Priority or date with an invalid format

409.description: The start date is after the end date

get.description: Returns the count and percentage of incidents for each priority level (LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL).

400.description: Priority or date with an invalid format

409.description: The start date is after the end date

get.summary: Get AI query history for an incident
get.description: Returns every query sent to n8n for an incident, with its responses, sources, similarities and ratings.
Returns every AI query, newest first. Optional filter by status.

KnowledgeArticleRequestDTO.description: Data to create or edit a technical knowledge base article

problem.example: Remote users cannot establish the corporate VPN tunnel.

cause.example: The perimeter firewall blocks UDP 500 and 4500 (NAT-T).

solution.description: Solution or steps to resolve it
solution.example: 1. Allow UDP 500/4500 on the firewall. 2. Restart IKEEXT on the client.

authorUserId.description: ID of the user who writes the article (optional)

CreateIncidentRequestDTO.description: Data required to register a new incident in the system

title.example: Database connection pool exhausted in ERP

description.description: Detailed description of the symptom or technical error
description.example: HikariPool-1 timeouts occurring every 10 minutes on production node 2

userId.description: ID of the user who reports the incident

categoryId.description: ID of the related technical category

IncidentResponseDTO.description: Response with the detail of a registered incident

AiResponseDTO.description: REST contract that n8n sends back with the AI diagnosis and its source documents

aiQueryId.description: ID of the original AI query (AiQuery) that triggered the analysis

suggestedDiagnosis.description: Likely diagnosis generated by the AI agent
suggestedDiagnosis.example: Possible UDP port 500/4500 (IPSec NAT-T) block on perimeter firewall

solutionSteps.description: Recommended steps to resolve the incident
solutionSteps.example: 1. Verify UDP 500 and 4500 rules. 2. Restart IKEEXT service on client.

processingTimeMs.description: Total processing time of the n8n workflow, in milliseconds

sources.description: List of articles or source documents that support the response (RAG)

SourceDTO.description: Source document or knowledge article cited by the AI

knowledgeArticleId.description: Optional ID of the article in the knowledge_articles table

sourceTitle.description: Title of the manual, guide or reference ticket

referenceUrl.description: URL or identifier of the document in the knowledge base

citedSnippet.description: Text excerpt extracted by the n8n RAG workflow
citedSnippet.example: Error 809 occurs when IKE packets are blocked by NAT-T...

similarityScore.description: Semantic similarity score between the incident and the source (0.0 to 1.0)

CreateRatingRequestDTO.description: Request to record the human rating of an AI response

evaluatorUserId.description: ID of the user or technician who rates the response

score.description: Score on a 1 to 5 star scale

helpful.description: Whether the AI suggestion helped to resolve the incident

feedbackComment.example: The suggested firewall rule check solved the VPN issue immediately

RatingResponseDTO.description: Response with the data of the recorded rating

AiAssistanceRequestDTO.description: REST contract to request the analysis of a technology incident in n8n

incidentId.description: Unique ID of the incident registered in the system

detailedDescription.description: Detailed technical description of the reported problem
detailedDescription.example: Remote users receive error 809 when connecting from Windows 11 clients

additionalPromptContext.description: Additional context to refine the prompt sent to the agent in n8n
additionalPromptContext.example: Check if this matches yesterday's firewall certificate update

AiFailureReportDTO.description: AI workflow failure reported by n8n

aiQueryId.description: Query ID (must match the path; optional)

message.example: Could not generate the query embedding.

technicalDetail.description: Technical detail (never shown to the end user)

processingTimeMs.description: Time spent in n8n before the failure

UpdateKnowledgeArticleStatusDTO.description: Activates/deactivates or verifies an article. Omitted fields do not change.

active.description: true to activate, false to deactivate

verified.description: true to mark it as verified

UpdateIncidentStatusRequestDTO.description: Request to update the status of an existing incident

CategoryResponseDTO.description: Technical category of incidents and knowledge articles

WeeklyTrendDTO.description: Weekly trend of reported and resolved incidents

totalReported.description: Total incidents reported in that week

totalResolved.description: Total incidents resolved or closed in that week

CategoryMetricDTO.description: Incident frequency grouped by technical category

incidentCount.description: Total number of incidents registered in this category

percentageOfTotal.description: Percentage of all incidents that belong to this category

MonthlyTrendDTO.description: Monthly trend of reported vs resolved incidents

totalResolved.description: How many of those incidents are resolved or closed

AnalyticsDashboardDTO.description: Key performance indicators (KPIs) computed with SQL/JPQL queries for the dashboard (RF06)

resolvedIncidents.description: Total incidents in RESOLVED or CLOSED status

overdueIncidents.description: 10b. Total overdue pending incidents (> 48 hours unresolved)

averageAiRatingScore.description: Average usefulness rating of the AI responses (1 to 5 scale)

topCategories.description: 2 and 7. Incidents per category, most frequent first

incidentsByPriority.description: 3. Distribution of incidents by priority level

incidentsByStatus.description: 4. Distribution of incidents by current status

incidentCount.description: Number of incidents with this priority
Number of incidents in this status

AiQueryHistoryResponseDTO.description: Detailed history of a query sent to the AI, including its response, sources and rating
